decision.observation: Reverse moved the car: gear R at 0 mph, but the view has shifted — bales now at mid-left, car sitting on the dark tarmac well inside the lane. Red X lit, all dots dark. Lane runs up-screen and curves left toward the top, puddles along its right side, spectators and barrels on both verges.
decision.hypothesis: The pin is cleared and the car is centred on the lane; the reverse gear explains 0 mph. A plain throttle hold should cancel the roll and head up the lane.
decision.memory: S+D 0.8s broke the left-edge pin and left the car centred rather than back on the grass — a good recovery shape for left-edge pins.
